whyClickone.heroSubtitle: ClickOne was born from over 20 years of real experience in the service industry.
whyClickone.storyP1: ClickOne was born from real experience: over 20 years working with service businesses. In Brazil, we spent decades managing businesses, building and leading sales teams, and setting up companies from the ground up across various segments.
whyClickone.storyP2: This expertise was brought to the United States, where the reality of service business owners, especially immigrants, showed the same challenges: lack of time, missed calls, clients who won't wait.
whyClickone.storyP3: Over that time, we saw many dedicated business owners losing clients simply because they couldn't answer the phone while working. It wasn't a lack of quality. It was a lack of time.
whyClickone.storyP4: Many of these entrepreneurs are immigrants who built everything from scratch. We know this reality because we're part of it.
whyClickone.whyP1: ClickOne exists to solve a specific problem: making sure service businesses don't lose customers because they can't answer the phone.
whyClickone.whyP2: We use technology to do that. But we're not a tech company trying to sell tools. We're people who know the industry and put together a solution that works.
whyClickone.commitmentIntro: We don't believe in chatbot-only support. When you work with ClickOne, you get a real team that speaks English, Spanish and Portuguese.

intro.title: 1. Introduction

security.desc: We implement appropriate technical and organizational security measures designed to protect your personal information against unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction. These measures include encryption, firewalls, secure server infrastructure, and access controls. However, no method of transmission over the Internet or electronic storage is 100% secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security.

retention.desc: We retain your personal information for as long as necessary to fulfill the purposes for which it was collected, comply with our legal obligations, resolve disputes, and enforce our agreements. When we no longer need your information, we will securely delete or anonymize it.

california.title: 8. California Privacy Rights (CCPA/CPRA)
california.desc: If you are a California resident, you have specific rights under the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) and California Privacy Rights Act (CPRA). These include the right to know what personal information we collect, the right to delete your information, and the right to opt-out of the sale of your personal information. We do not sell personal information as defined under CCPA/CPRA. To make a request, please contact us using the information provided in this policy.

faq.title: Everything You Need to Know About
faq.subtitle: Clear, direct answers on how ClickOne AI answers every call, handles after-hours calls, and helps service businesses grow.
faq.q1: What is an AI receptionist for service businesses and how does it work?
faq.a1: An AI receptionist is a voice and chat assistant that answers customer calls 24/7. It speaks with a natural voice, understands what the caller needs, qualifies the job, collects the address, and books appointments directly into your calendar.
faq.q2: How does ClickOne AI handle emergency calls after hours?
faq.a2: ClickOne AI works 24/7. After hours, it listens for urgent situations (such as an active water leak, a heating or cooling failure in extreme weather, or a safety issue) and transfers the caller or sends a priority SMS alert to your on-call technician, while routine requests are booked for regular hours.
faq.q3: Can ClickOne AI integrate with my existing scheduling calendar or CRM?
faq.a3: Yes. ClickOne works with Jobber, Housecall Pro and QuickBooks, and connects to ServiceTitan, JobNimbus, Roofr and more through automation. It books appointments on your calendar, logs the lead details and sends confirmations to your team and the customer.
faq.q4: How much revenue can a local service business lose from missed calls?
faq.a4: It depends on your numbers. For example, a business that misses 5 calls a week, where about 20% of those calls would turn into jobs if someone answered, and an average job is worth $800, could be leaving about $3,464 a month on the table (5 x 4.33 x 20% x $800). Use the calculator on this page to run your own numbers.
faq.q5: How fast can ClickOne AI be set up for my business?
faq.a5: Recover is set up in 7 days. On Front Office, your AI voice receptionist is live in 7 days. We customize the voice, service menu, pricing details, FAQs and routing rules for your business, so you don't need any technical skills. Text messages switch on once US carriers approve your number, which usually takes 10+ business days.
faq.q6: What happens if the caller asks a complex question the AI cannot answer?
faq.a6: If a customer asks something the AI doesn't know, it politely collects their details, summarizes the request, and notifies your team for a personal follow-up, so no customer is left without an answer.

faq.q: What's included in the setup fee?
faq.a: We build everything for you: missed-call text-back, instant form replies, your lead pipeline, booking, confirmations, reminders, review requests and your monthly report. On Front Office we also set up your AI voice agent and connect Jobber, Housecall Pro or QuickBooks. Recover is set up in 7 days, and on Front Office your AI voice is live in 7 days.

faq.q: When do text messages start, and who pays the carrier fees?
faq.a: Text messages switch on once US carriers approve your business number (A2P 10DLC), which usually takes 10+ business days. Carrier registration and phone fees are billed at cost, separately from your monthly fee.

faq.q: What happens if I use more than 300 voice minutes?
faq.a: Front Office includes 300 AI voice minutes a month. Extra minutes are $0.25 each. Recover does not include AI voice answering.

faq.q: Is there a contract? Can I cancel?
faq.a: No long-term contract. You can cancel anytime.
